[P2] Wait for the active invocation before completing the drain path

For an oversized result, `handleExecutionUpdate` resolves `executionState` from the EXECUTION checkpoint before `InvokeHandler.invoke()` finishes. An awaited `onInvocationEnd` or `wrapInvocation` hook can still be flushing an exporter at this point. The drain only orders worker requests, so the new 0 ms completion path lets `run()` return and test teardown begin while that hook remains unfinished—even for short flushes that previously completed during the 100 ms wait. For checkpoint-resolved success, await the active invocation before stopping collection and returning. Add an oversized-result regression test with a delayed completion hook.
